This additional cost was recognized due to anticipated run-off costs and underlying adverse claims development, particularly in Hull, Cargo, and D&O/E&O classes. The 2017 year of account was significantly impacted by natural catastrophe events including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, and the Mexican Earthquake.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 104.513m. Analysis of the claims development triangle indicates a modest net favourable prior-year movement of approximately GBP 1.95m (a release, c.1.9% of opening gross reserves), driven by favourable development in the older underwriting years (notably 2015 and 2016) and recoveries. The 2017 underwriting year experienced material catastrophe losses (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria and the Mexican earthquake) which adversely impacted 2017 results, while run-off related costs and reinsurance considerations were also noted as factors affecting overall results.
